messages:
sophia: Hey team — quick callout: the admin form is long and has optional advanced blocks. Need to pick a validation approach before dev. inline-as-you-type, only-on-submit, or hybrid?

leo: Hybrid for me. Inline lightweight hints (gray helper text) on blur, but show a top banner summary on submit with a count.

maya: Agreed. Also tidy up required markers: visible asterisk + explicit '(required)' text for important fields so screen readers get it.

tony: For collapsed advanced sections, auto-expand the section on submit if it contains errors. Maybe animate so it's not jarring.

aria-bot: Accessibility checklist: form-level banner in aria-live region (assertive when submit fails), invalid fields use aria-invalid and aria-describedby, focus should go to first error on explicit action only.

sophia: Destructive action at the end (permanent delete of configuration). Should we do typed-confirm or modal+undo?

leo: Typed-confirm for permanent deletions of customer data. For bulk-removal of temporary items, modal + toast with undo window is better (fast for power users).

maya: Copy: banner -> 'Fix 3 errors to continue.' Typed-confirm label -> "Type DELETE to permanently remove 'ConfigName'". Keep it short and explicit.

ton y: Dev note: undo needs soft-delete backend; mark as Phase 2 if infra isn't ready. Phase 1 = hybrid validation + banner + mobile sticky submit with error badge.

sophia: Tests: keyboard-only submit, screen reader announcement on submit fail, mobile sticky CTA behavior, collapsed-section auto-expand. I'll author the RFC with acceptance criteria.

leo: I'll add Figma mocks for the hybrid banner + inline states and tag @design for review.
